### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **45** documentable anchor(s).

**57** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517`.

⛔ **17** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **159** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **159**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **22** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7de2dab0a943d3447d6b66080497407647ed69e3` — the merge of head `306a19fc8e6fdd5c809c4641d2a885d7c73182f3` into base `69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7de2dab0a943d3447d6b66080497407647ed69e3 && git checkout 7de2dab0a943d3447d6b66080497407647ed69e3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517 306a19fc8e6fdd5c809c4641d2a885d7c73182f3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517 && git merge --no-ff 306a19fc8e6fdd5c809c4641d2a885d7c73182f3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 69e133ea0d9734dd0447d08875bbd8e3af0e1517` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `677f474461d8885d95117cf5fba49cabfec6731d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts` (new), `scim-connection-admin.test.ts` (new), `scim-connection-service.ts` (append after line 243), `auth-manager.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`, `auth-route-ledger.ts`, `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-identity-audit-trail.dogfood.test.ts`, `admin-route-nonadmin-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`, `.changeset/30958-scim-connection-credential-door.md` + cited at this head and on `main`: `scim-connection-service.ts` whole (header contract, `CREDENTIAL_PROBE_CONTEXT`, `mintScimConnectionCredential`'s insert payload, `verifyScimBearerToken`'s inactive and expiry refusals and its `provisioningDomainId` default); `platform-admin-gate.ts` (`judgePlatformAdmin`, `judgeHeldSession` with the empty path, `PlatformAdminActor.impersonatedBy`); `auth-plugin.ts` `gateAdmin` (session read, verdict, impersonator handed back for attribution) and the sibling `/admin/*` mounts; `auth-actor-attribution.ts` `runAttributedToUser` (accepts the actor object at this head); `objectql-adapter.ts` `withSystemContext`; `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` `customSession` (`isPlatformAdmin` derived from the session user's positions, `impersonatedBy` read into the gate posture); `auth-manager.ts` `resolveScimEnabled`; `admin-user-endpoints.ts`'s own `sys_audit_log` insert (the precedent row shape); `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts` (`apiMethods: ['list']`, `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`, `requiredPermissions`, `token_digest` `internal: true`, `active`, `expires_at`, every text column `maxLength: 255`) and the six other `sys_scim_*` objects' `connection_id` / `provisioning_domain_id` columns (all 255); `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts` (`actor` 255, `metadata` textarea) and `audit-writers.ts` (`collectInternalReadFields`: an `internal` field is omitted from the ledger copy); `auth-route-ledger.ts` (`requires?: string`, the `server-only` contract and the sibling rows); `scripts/check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs` (mount-vs-ledger diff, the `server-only` note requirement); `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts` (`AuthManager` exported by name; no SCIM module exported); `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/CHANGELOG.md` entry `92b7bbd` (#28793, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `none`, Patch); `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`; AGENTS.md step 3; PR #30989's diff (`scim-connection-service.ts` hunk at lines 74–166, `auth-actor-attribution.ts`, `objectql-adapter.ts`, plugin-audit) and a three-way merge trial against this head.

Inputs read: card #30958 body and its four comments (triage 6687301683, seat claim 6687520822, door choice 6687604379, os-dev-report 6689313446); the dispatch order `dispatch-30958.md` on the project mount; PR #30991 body (at both heads), 13-file list, nine commits, the net diff vs `main` (merge-base `000a4c0d`, 9 ahead, `main` 0 ahead) and the one-commit delta `6c7e4361..677f4744`; the docs-drift comment 6689307318; both carriers through `clause2-line.mjs` at this head: `Clause-②` `value: yes, arm: widening`, `Metadata-protocol` `value: none`; the check-runs on `6c7e4361` (cancelled by the push, see ③) and on `677f4744`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) Only the platform administrator mints or revokes.** Both mounts' first statement is `await gateAdmin(c)`, before any body read; `gateAdmin` reads the session through the auth service's in-process `getSession` and hands it to `judgePlatformAdmin`: anonymous → 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`; a signed-in caller is first judged held (`judgeHeldSession` = `evaluateAuthGate(user, '')`, the fail-closed empty path, so an expired or forced password and an un-enrolled enforced MFA are refused 403 with the gate's own body, ADR-0069 D3); then `isPlatformAdminUser` (the derived `isPlatformAdmin`, else the legacy `role === 'admin'` scalar) → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Impersonation: `customSession` derives `isPlatformAdmin` from the session USER's positions, so an administrator impersonating a non-administrator is refused 403, and an impersonation session's posture is the account-scope gate (`computeAuthGate(..., { impersonation })`); `gateAdmin` hands `impersonatedBy` back on the actor for attribution only, the same as every sibling mount. No new judge, no copy of the predicate, no wider minter. Pinned: unit (member 403 / anonymous 401 on both doors, nothing written, the existing bearer still provisions) and the derived dogfood sweep (both routes classified `objectstack-gate`, which fails until a new `/admin/` route is classified). TRUE.
- **(b) The bearer and its digest appear in the mint response only.** The plaintext is generated inside `mintScimConnectionCredential`, returned to `runMintScimCredential`, placed in `data.token` with `Cache-Control: no-store`, and nowhere else: the row stores `token_digest` only (`internal: true`, so the engine's generic read path and plugin-audit's ledger copy both omit it; the dogfood `GET /data/...` 200 body and the `/export` 403 body are asserted free of both); the door's audit `metadata` is the closed type `{ event, connectionId }`; the audit-write warning names event, connection and credential id; a storage failure on the mint answers 500 and logs the error's name and `code` only, withholding the driver message (which can echo the inserted row, hence the digest). The mount's outer `catch` puts `err.message` in the 500 body and the error log, and I traced what can reach it: body parsing (returns a 400, never throws), the organization lookup (before any mint), and nothing after the mint, since the mint's own failure and the audit write are caught inside `runMintScimCredential` and the revoke's `update` payload is `{ id, active: false }`. Pinned by `expectSecretNowhereElse` (every audit row, every plugin-logger and console line, the at-rest row holds the digest and never the token, an engine read under system context serves neither) on every minting case, and by the dogfood W5 case over `sys_audit_log` (door rows and plugin-audit's generic mirror rows), `sys_activity`, the list and the export. TRUE.
- **(c) Level and declarations.** Two new served routes on an unconditional raw mount, two new public methods on the exported `AuthManager` (`isScimWired`, `mintScimConnectionCredential`), no refusal added to anything that was accepted before (the data API stays `list` only; no response, route or stored row moves): a pure widening, so `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the exact spelling, and `Metadata-protocol: none` is right (no metadata key, value or type moves; the door is a route, not a declared action). AGENTS.md step 3: `none` takes `patch`, and the fleet precedent for this exact class is `92b7bbd` (#28793, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/list-platform-admins`, `yes (widening)` / `none`, shipped as a Patch Change). The changeset carries both declaration lines, `Skills-docs`, the two routes with their bodies, codes and the once-shown token, the 246-character cap and its reason, rotation, the audit row, and "Nothing that existed changes". No `!`, no BREAKING section, no ADR-0087 marker: right for a widening. Both carriers read identically through `clause2-line.mjs`. TRUE.
- **(d) Ledger and classification.** Two `objectstack-mount` / `source: 'objectstack'` / `disposition: 'server-only'` rows, each note opening "no SDK method builds this URL —" and carrying the measurement `check-auth-mount-ledger` requires behind a `server-only` claim (who posts it, what it does, the codes, the gate, the ADR); the mint row carries `requires: 'scim'` and the revoke row none, which matches the code (the mint refuses 503 while SCIM is off; the revoke serves regardless) and the `sso/request-domain-verification` precedent of an unconditional mount whose capability needs the plugin. The tracker id sits in a comment, not the note, per the #16678 rule. The conformance test's hand-written objectstack set gains both routes with the reason spelled on the pin's own terms. `check:auth-mount-ledger` exit 0 locally per the report; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` was green on `6c7e4361` and is read again on this head below. TRUE.
- **(e) Revoke semantics.** `revokeScimConnectionCredential` reads `id, connection_id, active` under the probe context, answers `not_found` / `already_revoked` without writing, else writes `{ id, active: false }` with `{ context: { isSystem: true } }` spelled at the call; `verifyScimBearerToken` on `main` already refuses `active` not affirmatively true (sqlite `0` included), and the SCIM plugin holds no verified-bearer cache (the unit pin drives `POST /Users` with the revoked bearer in-process and gets 401 on the next request; the dogfood pin does the same over HTTP). Rotation is a second mint for the same `connection_id` (the object header's staged rotation) then this; the successor still provisions (pinned). 404 and 409 are the existing codes; a second revoke writes no row and no audit row (pinned). TRUE.
- **(f) #30960 / PR #30989 collision.** PR #30989 (`727dacbe`, server seat 5) edits `scim-connection-service.ts` in one hunk at lines 74–166 (the request-scope type, `recordScimRequestConnection`, `scimRequestConnectionId`, `scimServicePrincipal`, `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX`); this PR appends after line 243 and edits nothing above. `git merge-tree` of the two heads over their merge base: zero conflict markers. The other files #30989 touches (`auth-actor-attribution.ts`, `objectql-adapter.ts`, `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`, plugin-audit) are read here but not edited. The one semantic tie is the carry below: `'svc:scim:'` is spelled literally in `scim-connection-admin.ts` while #30989 exports it as `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX`; whichever lands second owes a one-line import (nit). No collision. TRUE.
- **The 246-character cap (the delta commit `677f4744`).** `MAX_SCIM_CONNECTION_ID = 255 - 'svc:scim:'.length` = 246, with the reason in its docblock; the refusal is the existing 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` with the limit in its message. Where a 246-character id lands: `sys_scim_connection_credential.connection_id` (255) and `provisioning_domain_id` (255, and the verifier's default is the connection id itself, so a 246-character domain fits), every other `sys_scim_*` object's `connection_id` / `provisioning_domain_id` (binding, group, group member, identity tombstone, projection grant, user: all 255), `sys_audit_log.actor` as `svc:scim:` + id (exactly 255 under #30989), the door's audit `metadata` (textarea, unbounded) and its warning line (a log string), the revoke path (reads the id from the row, writes `id` and `active` only), and the mint response. Safe everywhere; the unit pin mints 246 (200, stored) and refuses 247 (400, nothing stored) and asserts `9 + 246 === 255`. TRUE.
- **Organization ownership.** A named `organizationId` must exist (400 otherwise); none named → `findDefaultOrganization`; several with no default → 400 asking for `organizationId`; no `sys_organization` object → no owner. It decides the row's owner only; the gate decided the caller. Pinned (named org stored; unknown org 400 with nothing stored). Reasonable and stated in the PR, the changeset and the docs.
- **Census artefacts.** `check-tenant-audit-census` requires regeneration when application-surface write sites change; the two new writes (`sys_audit_log` insert, credential `update`) spell `{ context: { isSystem: true } }` at the call and the ledger reads both as decidably elevated (261 → 263, the "provably no tenant context" figure stays 2, the earlier `scim-connection-service.ts` insert row unchanged). Off the dispatch surface, reported as a deviation, required by the gate. Honest.
- **Docs.** `authentication.mdx` is hand-written (not under `references/`), and the new section states the curl, the once-shown token, the 503, revoke's 404 / 409, rotation, the cap and the audit row, matching the code at this head. `Skills-docs: updated here` is honest; `skills/**` teaches no SCIM setup.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, the one package the diff moves (`packages/qa/dogfood` moves tests only). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on both carriers, one line-initial key each; `none` ⇒ `patch` by AGENTS.md step 3, precedent `92b7bbd`. No breaking banner is owed and none is carried. The published type surface widens by the two `AuthManager` methods and the routes; the changeset names the routes and not the methods (nit).

Check-runs on `677f4744` at 16:17Z: 53 so far — 32 `completed/success`, among them `TypeScript Type Check` (all four lanes: `Type Check · source gates / workspace / debt ledger / consumer gates`), `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Check Changeset`, `Lint & Repo Gates` with every `Lint ·` leg (`repo & tooling gates` carries `check:auth-mount-ledger` and `check-tenant-audit-census`), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `PR-body guards`, `Spec property liveness`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Test Core (5/8)`, `Test UI`, `Live E2E UI`; 14 `completed/skipped`; 7 `in_progress` (`Test Core` 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 of 8); none failed. The unit file, the ledger conformance test and the two dogfood pins ride the Test Core shards still running, so the all-green landing precondition is the seat's to read on this head. On the superseded `6c7e4361` the `TypeScript Type Check` failure was the aggregator reporting a lane the push had cancelled, not a type error, and every lane is green here.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The branch moved after the order: the ordered head `6c7e4361` gained one commit, `677f4744` (the 246 cap, a carry from server seat 5's #30960), with no merge; the runs on `6c7e4361` were cancelled by the push (`Lint & Type Check` and `CI` concluded `cancelled`; the aggregate `TypeScript Type Check` reported `typecheck-consumers` as `cancelled`, not a type error). This record is on `677f4744`; every judgment above was made on it, and the only code difference from `6c7e4361` is the cap and its pin.
- `open_questions`: none. Out of scope, noted by the dev and right to leave: a Setup button (a platform-objects metadata hunk, outside the file surface; the seat files it); widening the minter to an organization administrator (a maintainer decision; not proposed).
- Off the dispatch surface: the two census artefacts (gate-required, above). Hot files: none of #30959 / #30960's projection or attribution code is touched.
- The PR body still says `minted_by_user_id = the admin` in two places; the column the service writes is `user_id` (the input key is `mintedByUserId`). Prose only (nit).
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; the PR is a draft; `Fixes #30958`; no governed surface touched (Tier S).
- Independence: rendered by an isolated contract-review subagent fed the card, the dispatch, the door-choice and report comments, the PR at both heads, the net and delta diffs, the cited code at this head and on `main`, PR #30989's diff, the gate sources and the check-runs, not the seat's conclusions; adopted by the seat named in `Reviewed-by:`.

### ④ Design judgment

- Route over action, as recorded before building (6687604379): the one proven judge (`judgePlatformAdmin`, ADR-0068 D2 + ADR-0069 D3) runs ahead of the body read, exactly as the sibling `/admin/*` mounts; an action would have needed a second copy of the predicate at the platform action door. The derived sweep forces classification of both routes. Holds.
- `scim-connection-admin.ts` keeps the secret's path short and closed: minted inside the service, answered once, digest at rest `internal`, audit metadata a closed type, the storage failure's cause withheld. The audit row is written directly as `/admin/create-user` writes its own (same columns, same declared skip when plugin-audit is absent, same one-warning-no-undo on a refused write). Holds against the precedent and the object's posture.
- The service edit is an append that reuses the verifier's own reading of `active` and the probe context; the verifier is untouched, so verification and revocation cannot disagree. Holds.
- Seven ablations (gate, revoke write, audit row, audit secret, log secret, SCIM-off, secret binding), each red for its own reason and restored, reported with their failing assertions. Holds.

Findings (none must-fix):

- **nit** — `scim-connection-admin.ts` spells `'svc:scim:'` literally for the cap; PR #30989 exports it as `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX` from `scim-connection-service.ts`. Whichever lands second: import the constant so the cap cannot drift from the actor prefix. Carrier the seat, one line, with #30989's landing.
- **nit** — the changeset names the two routes and not the two new public `AuthManager` methods (`isScimWired`, `mintScimConnectionCredential`), which are on the published class; one "Exported" line as `92b7bbd` carried would make the widening complete on the record.
- **nit** — PR body: `minted_by_user_id` → the column is `user_id` (input `mintedByUserId`); two mentions.
- **nit** — the door's own audit row names the admitted administrator (`user_id` / `actor` = the impersonated admin's id on an impersonation session) and not `impersonatedBy`, as `/admin/create-user`'s own row does not either; plugin-audit's generic mirror rows carry the attribution `runAttributedToUser` now hands them. Consistent with the sibling; a `metadata.impersonatedBy` would make the door's row self-sufficient. Carrier none unless the seat wants it with the Setup follow-up.

队列构建 [42254111633](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42254111633) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
